comparison.objective: Seat a drink cup in a manual sealer and operate the lever long enough to fuse the film.
comparison.physical_skill: Cup placement and sustained lever actuation while keeping hands out of a pinch zone.
comparison.success_condition: All 36 rim points sealed after 3 s contact, lever raised, cup stable; spill or pinch-zone intrusion fails.
comparison.reason: Tests sealing under sustained compression and machine safety, not impulsive fracture, lateral-load control, or fragment recovery.
